decision.reasoning_trace: I am looking for a reliable, portable, and waterproof Bluetooth speaker for outdoor use. My consideration set focused on reputable brands and speakers with high ratings. The JBL Go 3 stands out because it has a very high rating of 4.7 with over 500 reviews, is from a trusted brand (JBL), and offers an IP67 rating at a very reasonable price of $39.99. While the JBL Clip 3 is also excellent, the Go 3 provides a more modern design at a lower cost. I considered the BOGASING M4 for its power, but the compact reliability of the JBL Go 3 makes it the preferred choice for a portable setup. I avoided the accessories (cases and cables) and the less-reliable DOSS Traveler which had reviews mentioning it died after 2 months.
